MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

2. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 40

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 17
   C. 21
   D. 15

4. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 13
   C. 169
   D. 26

5. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 33
   C. 12
   D. 4

6. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

7. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 36

8. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 144
   C. 156
   D. 24

9. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 50

10. Solve for x: x + 8 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 8
   C. 11
   D. 10

11. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 10
   D. 26

12. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 16
   C. 8
   D. 17

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

2. Substitute values: c² = 9² + 12²
3. c² = 81 + 144
4. c² = 225
5. c = 15
Final Answer: 15 cm
